title: Pickleball Advanced Protocol
tagline: Power. Speed. Reaction. Resilience. Next-Level Performance.
goal: Build maximal strength and power • Improve acceleration and deceleration • Enhance rotational force and stability • Train reactive movement and lateral change • Develop muscular endurance for longer play • Maintain shoulder health and control

Week 4 ADVANCED GOALS item 3 reads 'Increase retational force and stability' (sheet typo for 'rotational'); kept as printed.
Week 2 KEY CUES last item reads 'Move pain-freet' (stray 't', sheet typo); recorded in week 2 notes, top-level principles use 'Move pain-free' as on weeks 1, 3, 4 and 6.

Exercise names, workout headings and the time box are printed in ALL CAPS on the sheets (some with a lowercase 'to'/'To', e.g. 'LATERAL SKATER BOUND to STICK', 'REVERSE LUNGE To KNEE DRIVE'); recorded in title case with 'to' lowercase, matching the pickleball-intermediate file convention.
Week 1 Workout C row 6 'Burpee to Lateral Shuffle' is dosed '3 × 8 each side' on the sheet; recorded as printed.

Time boxes printed as '45–60 MINUTES' / '50–60 MINUTES' with an en dash; recorded as '(45-60 min)' / '(50-60 min)' with an ASCII hyphen, as for warm-up '(8–10 MIN)' and recovery '(5–10 MIN)'. Other ranges ('Stick 2–3 seconds', '2–5 minutes', '(10–15 yd)') likewise converted to ASCII hyphens.
sourceNotes: Read 5 sheets (weeks 1, 2, 3, 4, 6), each 1536x1024 from Drive thumbnails at w2400; there is no Week 5 sheet in the Drive. Every sheet has the same layout: header (MD FIT Performance & Rehab, 'Move better. Play longer.', 'PICKLEBALL ADVANCED PROTOCOL', '6-WEEK PROGRAM | WEEK n', tagline 'POWER. SPEED. REACTION. RESILIENCE. NEXT-LEVEL PERFORMANCE.'), an 'ADVANCED GOALS WEEK n' box (different every week; each week's goals are in that week's notes, top-level 'goal' = week 1 goals), Workouts A/B/C with 6 rows each (time box 45-60 MINUTES in weeks 1-3, 50-60 MINUTES in weeks 4 and 6), PRE-WORKOUT WARM-UP (8-10 MIN) with 5 items, KEY CUES (EVERY WORKOUT) box (= top-level principles), and POST-WORKOUT RECOVERY (5-10 MIN) with 4 items. Warm-up, key cues and recovery are identical on all five sheets except the week 2 'pain-freet' typo. No weekly focus line, no 6-week progression strip and no footer text are printed, so week 'focus' and progression fields are empty; the sheets do not state how many workouts per week. Workout headings, time boxes and descriptions change from week to week and are recorded per exercise.
